verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਮਜੀਠ ਤੇ ਕਮਾਦ ਵਾਂਗ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਮੋੜਦੇ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 13 : gurmukh majeeTh te kamaadh vaa(n)g sevaa to(n) moo(n)h nahee(n) moRadhe

en.bdb: Madder (Rubia munjista) knowing very well gets itself grinded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛਡੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kadhe na chhaddai sa(n)g banat banaiaa|

en.bdb: Its character is such that it never deserts the clothes.
Likewise, the sugarcane also care freely gets itself crushed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੈ ਨ ਮਨ ਰਸ ਭੰਗੁ ਅਮਿਓ ਚੁਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: karai na man ras bha(n)g amio chuaaiaa|

en.bdb: Without leaving away its sweetness offers the taste of nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡ ਅਚੰਗੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: guR sakar kha(n)dd acha(n)g bhog bhugaiaa|

en.bdb: It produces jaggery, sugar, treacle molasses many relishable items.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਨ ਮੋੜਨ ਅੰਗੁ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: saadh na moRan a(n)g jag parachaiaa ||13||

en.bdb: Similarly, the saints also do not abstain from the service of mankind, and give happiness to all.
